description:
This is a special notice to inform vendors that DLA Energy is conducting a live Question and Answer on March 16, 2026 at 0900-1200.

RSVP for the form is by March 12, 2026 to email address uk2025@dla.mil. The Zoom link will provided to you by your company email.

Registration Form- https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/Qz3pMrJdTY
